### Q-006 — Where should a runtime utility live: core/blong is types only, blong-lib holds utility functions?

> _2026-11-25 · core/blong · answered_

Asked: 2026-11-25 — "where should a runtime utility live: core/blong is types only, blong-lib holds
utility functions"

Answer: Settled: a runtime helper that is not a declaration belongs in the utility package, not in
@feasibleone/blong — the perf toolkit moved to @feasibleone/blong-lib/perf and @@D-1016 holds the
reasoning, including why @feasibleone/blong-allure was rejected as its home. The rule the move rests
on is that core/blong is the framework's type surface, so a new module there needs to be part of
that surface; anything else goes to the package whose description already matches it.

Evidence: @@D-098 (0.810) @@F-554 (0.738) @@D-059 (0.735) @@D-099 (0.723) @@D-971 (0.713) @@F-119
(0.710) @@D-831 (0.706) @@F-648

Certainty: 0.85

Confirmed: yes — moved the module, ran its tests and both packages' suites, and proved the old
subpath is no longer exported
